name: WISE 0855-0714
note: Coordinates from the challenge text (08h55m10.831s, -07d14m42.53s). Fast mover (~8 arcsec/yr): use a larger FOV, and expect a few pixels of motion across the survey.

name: Barnard's Star
note: Moves ~10.3 arcsec/yr. J2000 ICRS (17h57m48.50s, +04d41m36.11s) is ~4.5 arcmin away by 2026, so proper motion is propagated to the observation epoch.

name: Epsilon Indi B (Ba/Bb)
note: Brown dwarf pair (J2000 22h04m10.52s, -56d46m57.7s), shares the high proper motion (~4.7 arcsec/yr) of Epsilon Indi A.

name: RW Aurigae
note: T Tauri variable star (J2000 05h07m49.57s, +30d24m05.16s); exhibits large optical and near-IR brightness variations.

name: R Draconis
note: Mira-type pulsating red giant variable star (J2000 16h32m40.23s, +66d45m17.09s) with a ~245.6-day period.
